conditions: One local game tab; unthrottled CPU/network; focus emulated. Cold means browser network cache disabled, not an OS/GPU/WASM-cache reset. Warm enables browser cache; localhost response headers are recorded. Raw first-drive intervals retained.
baseline: Historical N01B final measurements; no paired same-day baseline rerun. Cold 6.971/7.226 s median/p95; warm 9.061/11.170 s. Different block, run length and interrupted session; no isolated causal conclusion.
limits: All 255 scenes load initially; 12 west can unload later, 243 pinned. Not whole-East-Village startup scalability.
One isolated desktop browser/profile, no CPU/network throttling. Cache disabled does not reset OS/GPU/WASM caches.
Startup medians are slower than historical N01B. Ninth-east has 31.4 ms p95 and 35.3 ms maximum; other legs 18.6–18.7 ms p95. No detail was reduced to improve figures.
No mobile, calibrated RAM, or stable whole-project speed claim. Browser counters are not total process memory.
